### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge** (non-blocking, *hypothesis — needs V-B-A before implementation*): `capturePerspectiveCue` re-saves the working layout after a topology capture. Its own JSDoc gives the reason: the capture selects the new record, so the next automatic save would overwrite the capture. The film composes two product seams correctly. But an agent calling `capture_perspective` with topology scope over the Neural Link, and stopping there, would get save-as semantics and silently lose its snapshot to later autosaves. If that holds at the tool seam, the defect belongs to the dock perspective layer, not the tour. I have not verified the tool-side behavior, so I file nothing here.

### 🧠 Graph Ingestion Notes

*   **`[KB_GAP]`**: A perspective restore is semantic: it can return panes to a closed window's workspace and open nothing. Re-birth is a separate, user-activated request (`workspace-open`), because `window.open` needs the gesture.
*   **`[TOOLING_GAP]`**: Native initial position is invisible headless, so the new geometry test self-skips at `chrome === 0`. Hosted CI therefore never exercises it; the headed receipt in the PR body is the only witness.
*   **`[RETROSPECTIVE]`**: Fence lifecycle flags by the window generation they describe. A retirement that settles after detachment must not mark the next window.
